description: A shell library for common git merge tool functions, including configuration, tool selection, and execution logic.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is diff or merge and if the corresponding tools can be used.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a specified merge tool is available in the system.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools from git config for a given section.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays available tools based on condition and mode.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Returns true if current mode is diff.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Returns true if current mode is merge.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines default GUI setting based on mode and environment.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Checks if GUI mode is enabled.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Translates merge tool name to its executable path.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies if the merge result is unchanged.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Validates if a tool is properly configured and available.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Sets up user-defined merge tool commands.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes tool-specific functions and configurations.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command to run a specific merge tool.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines if the merge tool's exit code can be trusted.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Loads tool-specific functions into scope.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Executes the merge or diff tool based on mode.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured diff command.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured merge command, handling trust and unchanged checks.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of candidate merge tools based on environment.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information for available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Guesses an appropriate merge tool if none is configured.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the merge tool set in git config.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Gets the executable path for a merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Determines the merge tool to use, either configured or guessed.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Finds Windows executable path for a tool.
